title: 9/5/2026 | Clayton Tucker | PC | Comments of Clayton Tucker Regarding the 765-kV Strategic Transmission Expansion Plan.

=== Public Comment Regarding the 765-kV Strategic Transmission Expansion Plan.pdf ===
September 1st, 2026

To the Commissioners of the Public Utility Commission of Texas:

My name is Clayton Tucker. I am a rancher from Lampasas, Secretary of the Texas Farmers Union,
and a candidate for Texas Agriculture Commissioner. I urge the Public Utility Commission to halt the
proposed 765-kV Strategic Transmission Expansion Plan until the Texas Legislature expressly
authorizes these projects and stronger protections are put in place for Texas landowners and
ratepayers.

This issue is personal to me. A few years ago, my family had to fight the Lower Colorado River
Authority over plans to put massive transmission lines through our family farm. I know firsthand what
it is like for a family to fight to protect its land.

The proposed 765-kV expansion could take productive farms and ranches out of use, reduce
property values, disturb soil, and leave landowners fighting to protect their own property. Texans
deserve meaningful input before projects of this size move forward. Landowners should be involved
from the beginning, rather than after major decisions have already been made.

We also need to be clear about who will pay for this expansion. Texas is facing enormous new
electricity demand from AI data centers and other large-load customers. Rural Texans should not
lose their land while working families across the state are stuck with higher electric bills to build
infrastructure serving some of the wealthiest corporations in the world.

Texas needs a reliable electric grid, but we should build it responsibly and with the consent of the
people it affects. I urge the PUC to halt the 765-kV STEP projects until the Legislature expressly
authorizes this expansion, landowners have a meaningful seat at the table, and safeguards ensure
ordinary Texans are not forced to shoulder the costs created by massive new corporate loads.

Our electric grid should serve Texans. Texans should not be forced to serve the grid.

Respectfully,




Clayton Tucker​
Candidate for Texas Agriculture Commissioner​
Rancher, Lampasas, Texas
